skills.name: music-video-editor
skills.description: Edit and composite multitrack music video recordings — sync separately-recorded video clips to a master audio track, then build a layered Remotion composition with layouts (full-frame, split-screen, picture-in-picture, grid) and transitions (slide, fade, cut). Use this skill whenever the user wants to combine multiple takes of musical performance footage with a master mix, mentions multitrack recording, asks to align video clips with audio, wants to make a split-screen performance video, or describes any workflow where they recorded the same song multiple times on different instruments and want the takes composited together. Triggers on phrases like "music video", "sync these clips", "split-screen performance", "I recorded my <instrument> separately", "multitrack composite".

skills.name: scaffold-skill

Use when you want to capture something we just figured out as a reusable /<name> slash command, without the full eval/iterate loop. For Anthropic's rigorous draft-test-grade-iterate framework, use anthropic-skill-creator instead.
